verdict.rationale: The evidence shows DBOS ships a well-documented Python SDK (dbos-docs-4 through dbos-docs-10, dbos-gh-1). A community comment (dbos-comm-4) says TypeScript and Python are supported, and the Vercel AI integration page (dbos-docs-38) hints at a TypeScript path. Nothing in the pack covers Go or other languages, and there is no evidence of feature parity across SDKs: every tutorial cited is Python-only. Missing for 10: evidence of a Go SDK or other languages, first-party TypeScript SDK documentation, any documented cross-SDK feature parity.
